description: Données du service d’Assistance Voyageur Handicapé en gare is a dataset listed in SNCF Open Data, an open data portal of a railway operator, published or maintained by SNCF. Liste des informations de l’assistance aux personnes en situation de handicap et aux personnes à mobilité réduite dans les gares SNCF (horaires, lieu de rendez vous,...) Les données affichées sont les suivantes: IdGare: Identifiant de la gare (jointure possible avec le référentiel des gares) NomGare: Nom de la Gare typePriseEnCharge: Type de prise en charge ... Coverage: France. The portal files it under Gares, Services voyageurs, Services gare. Its keywords are Services d'assistance, Horaires, Assistance, PSH, PMR, Assistance Voyageur Handicapé. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Data Commons Open Database License (ODbL) (https://data.sncf.com/pages/licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-sncf-open-data-portal.
